FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A01
Motorists must hunt for bikes twice over, peering before every intersection entry and every lane change [A01].
Why it matters: group bike-scan; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec12-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A01
Bikes look farther than they are, slow without brake lights, and dodge driver-assist sensors, a triple invisibility trap [A01].
Why it matters: group bike-traps; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec12-F02, sec12-F04, sec12-F09 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec12-R03 | anchor: A01
Following a bike means no tailgating plus a gap past 4 seconds, stretched wider for weather, gusts, slick or broken pavement, gravel, and rails [A01].
Why it matters: group bike-gap; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec12-F03, sec12-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec12-R04 | anchor: A01
Pass riders only with full room since wind blast topples, hold your lane when they pass you, and signal every lane change [A01].
Why it matters: group bike-pass; difficulty medium; prereq sec12-R03; confusables sec12-F05, sec12-F06, sec12-F08 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec12-R05 | anchor: A01
Public-road riding starts at 16, under-18 riders serve 12 clean learner months first, and motorcycle operation adds an approved course plus endorsement or Motorcycle Only license [A01].
Why it matters: group rider-license; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec12-F10, sec12-F11, sec12-F12 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec12-R06 | anchor: A01
Mopeds ask only a Class E license with no endorsement, a lighter ticket than the motorcycle course-plus-endorsement path [A01].
Why it matters: group moped; difficulty medium; prereq sec12-R05; confusables sec12-F13 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec12-R07 | anchor: A01
Helmets bind every rider under 21 while riders 21 and up escape only with $10,000 medical coverage, PIP stays optional, and machines need annual tags while shunning bike and foot paths [A01].
Why it matters: group rider-gear; difficulty high; prereq sec12-R05; confusables sec12-F14, sec12-F15, sec12-F16 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec12-R08 | anchor: A01
Inside crosswalks and driveways, bike, skateboard, and skate riders legally become pedestrians whom drivers must strain to miss [A01].
Why it matters: group ped-status; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F17 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec12-R09 | anchor: A02
Drivers halt and hold for crosswalk walkers, stop for sidewalk users at every alley and driveway mouth, never block or overhang crossings, never pass a car stopped for a walker, and always stop before right on red [A02].
Why it matters: group crosswalk; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec12-F18, sec12-F19, sec12-F20, sec12-F21, sec12-F22 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec12-R10 | anchor: A02
Full stops with yields and extra caution go to white canes with red tips, service and guide animals, walkers, crutches, orthopedic canes, wheelchairs, children, and confused or incapacitated walkers [A02].
Why it matters: group vulnerable; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec12-F23 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec12-R11 | anchor: A02
Walkers take sidewalks when present, face traffic on the left shoulder without one, cross at intersections or crosswalks, and yield to cars outside crossings or under red and DON’T WALK signals [A02].
Why it matters: group ped-duties; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec12-F24, sec12-F25, sec12-F26, sec12-F27, sec12-F28 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec12-R12 | anchor: A02
Street smarts mean crossing at crosswalks never between parked cars, looking left-right-left from the curb, glowing neon with a night flashlight, and ditching texts and headphones [A02].
Why it matters: group ped-tips; difficulty low; prereq sec12-R11; confusables sec12-F29 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec12-R13 | anchor: A02
Same-direction buses flashing back into traffic from signed pullouts own the right-of-way over drivers [A02].
Why it matters: group transit; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F30 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec12-R14 | anchor: A03
Stop-signal buses freeze both directions on undivided roads until the signal falls and children clear, and passing one is flatly illegal [A03].
Why it matters: group bus-stop; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec12-F31, sec12-F32 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec12-R15 | anchor: A03
Only a raised barrier or unpaved median 5 feet or wider frees opposite traffic, paint never counts, same-direction drivers always halt, and divided roads free only the far side with caution [A03].
Why it matters: group bus-divided; difficulty high; prereq sec12-R14; confusables sec12-F33, sec12-F36 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec12-R16 | anchor: A03
School guards step in first and out last, and drivers yield to a stop at the line outside the crosswalk while children or guards hold it [A03].
Why it matters: group school-xing; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec12-F34 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec12-R17 | anchor: A03
Sub-25-MPH farm rigs wear the rear emblem on public roads short of interstates and park after dark without proper lamps and reflectors [A03].
Why it matters: group slow-vehicle; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F35 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0097]
